zones: the selected card is otherwise authorized to be cast and is represented by a trusted face-pinned CardProgram
objects: phased-in untapped creatures currently controlled by the spell's caster
state_reads: current effective card types and colors
available mana sources and spend restrictions
state_writes: tap each selected creature transactionally through the canonical tap-state owner
costs: each selected creature pays one generic mana or one mana of one of that creature's current colors
Convoke cannot pay a colorless requirement
Convoke applies while paying the total cost after that total has been determined
a selected creature cannot also be activated as a mana source for the same spell
timing: the Convoke selection is made after activating mana abilities and while paying the spell's total cost
choices: the caster selects zero or more distinct currently eligible creatures
the server derives a deterministic whole-vector colored or generic contribution plan
hidden_information: the spell remains visible only to seats legally entitled to see its origin zone until casting makes it public
layers: candidate creature status and colors come from the canonical current effective-characteristic query
replacement_effects: cost-payment replacement effects are outside this bounded family and fail closed
copy: a copied spell was not cast and does not use Convoke
control_change: only the caster's currently controlled creatures are eligible at offer, validation, and commitment
zone_change: changing zone or logical incarnation invalidates a selected candidate before mutation
source_leaves: the spell and every selected creature are revalidated immediately before payment commitment

variants: multiple ordinary printed instances are redundant
summoning sickness does not prevent a creature from being tapped for Convoke
hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, and unrepresented cost symbols or cost-modification interactions remain explicit residuals
Convoke granted or removed after compilation and Convoke-equivalent rules text remain unsupported
